name: Research Town
description: Simulator of a research community in which LLM agents write proposals, review them and respond, modelled as a graph.
whatItDoes: Simulates researchers collaborating on ideas, drafting proposals and running peer review, for people studying automated research. It can be used as a package or with a small web front end.
howItWorks: Researchers and papers are nodes in an agent-data graph and research activities are message passing over it. A FastAPI backend and a JavaScript front end sit on top of the Python library.
